label: PF Backlog 695
title: Pluggable Hybrid Retrieval Engine: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), BM25 keyword scoring, and semantic reranking over MemoryRepository
body:
## Problem / why
Pure vector search suffers from semantic drift and poor keyword matching; pure lexical search fails on semantic paraphrasing.

## Goal & value
Implement hybrid retrieval combining dense vector embeddings (via datastore.MemoryRepository) with BM25 full-text search and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-8`
- `docs/RAG-PROCESS-MEMORY.md#section-8`

## In scope
- HybridSearchProvider interface querying both vector store and lexical indexes.
- Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) algorithm merging candidate ranked lists.
- Semantic reranking stage filtering near-duplicate spans and noise.

## Out of scope
- Hardware-accelerated cross-encoders in local CLI mode.

## Definition of Done
- Hybrid retrieval benchmarks demonstrate superior recall over vector-only and BM25-only baselines.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.

AC-2: Query equivalence and ranking stability verified across SQLite-vss and pgvector backends.
AC-3: Filters out chunks below relevance threshold and deduplicates overlapping document spans.
